added.message: Register `next_cnt_output` should use reg_/cnt_/state_/flag_/enc_/dec_ prefix or `_o` output suffix.
Internal non-array reg declaration `next_cnt_output` must be explicitly initialized inside the module; when backfilling a missing initializer, use exact ` = 0;`.
Counter-like signal `next_cnt_output` should use `cnt_` prefix.
Internal non-array reg declaration `flag_cnt_output_update` must be explicitly initialized inside the module; when backfilling a missing initializer, use exact ` = 0;`.
Counter-like signal `flag_cnt_output_update` should use `cnt_` prefix.
Always block `always@(*)` assigns multiple targets ['flag_cnt_output_update', 'next_cnt_output']; split to one target per always.
signal `next_cnt_output` should have a same-line semantic comment.
signal `flag_cnt_output_update` should have a same-line semantic comment.
signal `flag_pw_payload_eligible` should have a same-line semantic comment.
signal `flag_mac_payload_capture` should have a same-line semantic comment.
assign `flag_pw_payload_eligible` should have a same-line semantic comment.
assign `flag_mac_payload_capture` should have a same-line semantic comment.
Assign group comment must have exactly one blank line above unless it follows a region banner.
process assignment `next_cnt_output` should have a same-line semantic comment.
process assignment `flag_cnt_output_update` should have a same-line semantic comment.
Comment coverage is too low for generated RTL (1.79%); add semantic comments near declarations, assigns, always blocks, FSM, and instances.
